layers.label_en: Thermal inertia (night): low = loose dust, high = firm ground

layers.name: MGS MOLA MEGDR topography, 4 pixel/degree
layers.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-mola-5-megdr-l3-v1/mgsl_300x/meg004/megt90n000cb.lbl
layers.taken: megt90n000cb.img: elevation in metres above the GMM3 areoid, block-averaged 2 x 2 to 0.5 degree

layers.name: MGS TES thermal inertia, night map (Putzig & Mellon 2007)
layers.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-tes-5-timap-v1/mgst_9001/data/global_ti_night_2007.lbl
layers.taken: global_ti_night_2007.img: 16-bit integers, 20 pixel/degree, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2; values outside 5..5000 treated as no data; mean of valid pixels per 0.5 degree cell
layers.status: NASA data (PDS). Scoring ramp 100 to 300 tiu is a team assumption

layers.name: Annual mean surface temperature from an energy balance (Red Circle model)
layers.taken: solar irradiance 586.2 W/m2, Bond albedo 0.250, eccentricity 0.0935, obliquity 25.19 deg (NASA Mars Fact Sheet); see src/mars_survival/thermal.py
layers.status: Physics model, latitude only, an upper estimate with errors of about 10 K; not a measurement

layers.name: Derived from elevation (not measured)
layers.taken: P = 610 Pa x exp(-h / 11.1 km); dose = 0.67 mSv/day x (P / 850 Pa)^-0.25 anchored on one MSL RAD value (Gale crater)
layers.status: Physics model, exponent is a team hypothesis

layers.name: Odyssey GRS ns_epithermal_020917 (Feldman et al. 2002)
layers.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/ody/urn-nasa-pds-odyssey_grs_special/data/ns_epithermal_020917.lbl
layers.taken: epithermal neutron flux, counts/s, 0.5 degree cells, first 25.7 days of mapping; zero rows treated as no data
layers.status: NASA data; relative hydrogen proxy, not calibrated to water-equivalent hydrogen; seasonal CO2 frost mixes in at high latitude
